service.method: SELECT USMT.USER_ID AS APP_USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC AS APP_USER_NAME , GETDEPTNAME(${session.HOUSE_CODE}, USMT.COMPANY_CODE, USMT.DEPT, '') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME , USMT.DEPT AS DEPT , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO AS EMPLOYEE_NO , USMT.POSITION AS POSITION , USMT.COMPANY_CODE AS SELLER_CODE FROM SUDGL UDGL INNER JOIN SAPUD APUD ON UDGL.HOUSE_CODE = APUD.HOUSE_CODE AND UDGL.COMPANY_CODE = APUD.COMPANY_CODE AND UDGL.YD_NUMBER = APUD.KEY_NUMBER INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = APUD.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = APUD.COMPANY_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = APUD.APP_USER_ID AND USMT.DEPT = APUD.APP_USER_DEPT WHERE UDGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND UDGL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND UDGL.USE_NUMBER = ${USE_NUMBER} AND APUD.DEL_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY APUD.APP_SORT ASC

SELECT USMT.USER_ID AS APP_USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC AS APP_USER_NAME , GETDEPTNAME(${session.HOUSE_CODE}, USMT.COMPANY_CODE, USMT.DEPT, '') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME , USMT.DEPT AS DEPT , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO AS EMPLOYEE_NO , USMT.POSITION AS POSITION , USMT.COMPANY_CODE AS SELLER_CODE FROM SAPUD APUD INNER JOIN SSEAL SEAL ON APUD.HOUSE_CODE = SEAL.HOUSE_CODE AND APUD.COMPANY_CODE = SEAL.COMPANY_CODE AND APUD.KEY_NUMBER = SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = APUD.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = APUD.COMPANY_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = APUD.APP_USER_ID AND USMT.DEPT = APUD.APP_USER_DEPT WHERE SEAL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SEAL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER IN ($INS{MANAGER_NUMBER}) AND APUD.DEL_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY APUD.APP_SORT ASC

SELECT USMT.USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , USMT.POSITION , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO, DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC FROM SUSMT USMT LEFT OUTER JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = USMT.COMPANY_CODE AND DEPT.DEPT = USMT.DEPT WHERE USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND USMT.USER_ID = ${USER_ID}

SELECT USMT.USER_ID AS APP_USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC AS APP_USER_NAME , GETDEPTNAME(${session.HOUSE_CODE}, USMT.COMPANY_CODE, USMT.DEPT, '') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME , USMT.DEPT AS DEPT , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO AS EMPLOYEE_NO , USMT.POSITION AS POSITION , USMT.COMPANY_CODE AS SELLER_CODE FROM SBALN BALN LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON BALN.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID = USMT.USER_ID WHERE BALN.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BALN.COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND BALN.CTRL_CODE = ${CTRL_CODE} AND BALN.DEL_FLAG = 'N'

SELECT SRAD.SUBJECT FROM SSISD SISD INNER JOIN SSRAD SRAD ON SISD.HOUSE_CODE = SRAD.HOUSE_CODE AND SISD.COMPANY_CODE = SRAD.COMPANY_CODE AND SISD.SMI_NUMBER = SRAD.SMI_NUMBER WHERE SISD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SISD.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SISD.SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER}
SELECT * FROM SFILE WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DOC_NO = ${DOC_NO} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT TEXT1 AS SLM_NUMBER ,TEXT2 AS USE_NUMBER ,TEXT3 AS APPROVAL_SORT ,TEXT4 AS USER_ID ,TEXT5 AS ROLE FROM SCODE WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND TYPE = ${TYPE} AND LANGUAGE = 'KO' ORDER BY SLM_NUMBER ASC, APPROVAL_SORT ASC
SELECT * FROM SFILE WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DOC_NO = ${ATTACH_NO} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT ACCESS_LINK FROM ( SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , SMR_NUMBER , ACCESS_LINK FROM SSIPD WHERE ACCESS_LINK IS NOT NULL AND SMD_NUMBER = ${SMD_NUMBER} UNION ALL SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , SMR_NUMBER , ACCESS_LINK FROM SSISD WHERE ACCESS_LINK IS NOT NULL AND SD_NUMBER = ${SD_NUMBER} ) WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER}
SELECT * FROM SFILE WHERE DOC_NO = ${SMR_NUMBER} AND DEL_FLAG = 'N'
